+title: AgentThreadView, ConversationView, typed override modifiers, and the keyed registries (plan §3.6, §7, §8)
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Thread/AgentThreadView.swift`, `ConversationView.swift`, `ItemViewOverrides.swift`, and `Registries.swift`, per plan.md §3.6, §7, and §8.
+
+- `ItemViewOverrides`: one environment key per `ThreadItem` kind holding an optional `(Record) -> AnyView`. Typed modifiers `.systemPromptView`, `.userMessageView`, `.assistantMessageView`, `.reasoningView`, `.toolCallView`, `.structuredItemView`, `.compactionView`, `.errorView`, `.unknownItemView`.
+- `StructuredItemRegistry`: `.structuredItem(_ schemaName: String) { … }` writes into an environment dictionary; last writer wins. Resolution matches both a `.structured` item and a `structured` content block.
+- `ContentBlockRegistry`: `.contentBlockView(for: ContentBlockKind) { … }`.
+- `AttachmentRegistry`: `.attachmentView(for: UTType) { … }`. Resolution walks `UTType.supertypes` by conformance to the nearest registration, then falls back to the generic chip.
+- `AgentThreadView(thread)`: `ConversationView` with `ScrollView { LazyVStack { ForEach(thread.items, id: \.id) } }`. Each row is an `ItemRow` that reads only its record and applies `.equatable()` on `(id, revision)`. The switch over `ThreadItem` is internal and reads the overrides.
+- `ConversationView`: `defaultScrollAnchor(.bottom)`, `ScrollAnchorManager` wiring through `onScrollTargetVisibilityChange`, the scroll-to-bottom pill with the new-item count, an empty-state slot, and a "load earlier" row that windows older turns behind a page size.
+- Placeholder default views for each kind are fine here; the real item views come in later tasks.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `.toolCallView { … }` replaces the default for tool calls only.
+- [ ] `.attachmentView(for: .sourceCode)` resolves for a `.swiftSource` attachment; `.data` resolves to the chip.
+- [ ] Appending an item while pinned scrolls to bottom; while unpinned it increments the pill count.
+- [ ] A patch to one record re-renders that row only (count row body evaluations in a hosted test).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Thread/RegistryResolutionTests.swift`: schemaName last-writer-wins, UTType conformance walk.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Thread/AgentThreadViewHostedTests.swift`: mount, override, append, patch, row evaluation counts.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m2nra2jery7f4za09kqh7y0e
+  text: |-
+    ### implement — changed
+    - Decision: the environment has a new key `expandedBlocksStore: ExpandedBlocksStore?`. `AgentThreadView` gives its own store to the rows when the host gives none. `StructuredItemView` and `UnknownItemView` keep the expanded state in that store, keyed by record id. With no store, they keep local state; `isExpanded:` sets the start state. Later tasks (SystemPromptView, ReasoningView, ToolCallView) can read the same key.
+    - Decision: `ItemRow ==` compares the record object, the id, and the revision. A new record object with the same id and revision (remove, then insert) is then a different row.
+    - Decision: each kind reads its override through a private generic view with only its own environment key, so a change to one override does not invalidate rows of other kinds.
+    - Placeholders of the seven other kinds have the identifier `item-placeholder-<id>`.
+    - Shared disclosure: `Sources/AgentViewKit/Items/JSONDisclosure.swift`. A `.contain` element on it made the row identifier hide the inner identifier, so the identifier is on the disclosure itself.
+    - evidence: `swift test` green, 733 tests (566 in AgentViewKitTests).
+    - next: commit, then review.
+  timestamp: 2026-09-16T18:40:17.998374+00:00
